Harrowfield’s households paid more per resident. The tariff and unit conversion are the same for both districts, so compare water use per resident:

- Harrowfield: \(7,146,000 \div 90,212 \times 142.35 \approx 11,278\) tenge per resident
- Ossbridge: \(3,862,000 \div 52,904 \times 142.35 \approx 10,391\) tenge per resident
- Difference: approximately \(887\) tenge per resident

ANSWER: Harrowfield | 887
